specimen: real quiet TTS onset whose opener was missed by the original Whisper pass

source.extraction: ffmpeg PCM s16le mono 16000Hz, no gain or normalization
source.domainTransfer: The source surface is L1 voice_ask, while the target gate runs on narration BUILD segments; both expose the same missable-opener defect class through first-window energy versus the segment peak.

independentMeasurement.tool: ffmpeg astats on the raw source windows and extracted raw PCM
independentMeasurement.disclosure: The historical -8.13 dBFS value is a real one-second transient on the raw source around t=1206s, about 15 seconds before this fixture's opener. It is outside the 1221-1225s extract, so the earlier discrepancy is consistent with QA window misalignment, not loudness normalization; the relative onset defect reproduces without gain.
